mechanism_of_action: Angiotensin II receptor blocker acting on the AT 1 receptor subtype.
primary_endpoint: Change in serum ALT from baseline to 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 24 weeks, ALT changed by -5.3 U/L with losartan and -6.3 U/L with placebo (p=0.95, ANCOVA).
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 0/43 participants on losartan and 4/40 on placebo; no deaths in either group.
